items.title: AX Engineer, AIRS Medical
lines: I design, build and operate the Central Data Layer (OLAP, vector DB, graph DB) that collects the company's structured and unstructured data so AI agents can use it.

I build the company's AI Native Workspace (MCP servers, a workflow builder and a Flywheel engine). The more people use the workflows, the more data accumulates, and that data is used to improve the agents.
I work with domain teams such as Sales, Finance, RA/QA and CS to redesign their core workflows around AI.
I write the company's AI usage policy and skill guides and run monthly training sessions.

items.title: Claude Code agent operating setup and public configuration
items.what: I built and use daily a work relay that runs multiple Claude Code sessions back to back, unattended (when the context fills up, it hands off to the next session, and a watcher session handles permission requests), plus a SQLite task board that records state between sessions. I published the general-purpose parts of the setup, split into levels 1 to 4.
items.result: Public configuration repository: 14 stars, 3 forks (2026-11-23)
more: What the public set includes: a global CLAUDE.md, hooks, slash commands, subagents and 61 general-purpose skills.
Safety hooks: blocking dangerous commands, checking that file paths in answers exist, monitoring memory usage, and scanning for secrets before publishing.
machines-as-tools: one session calls other Macs through 19 MCP tools and hands them shell and browser tasks. Running across 3 Macs.
cmux-state-dashboard: shows dozens of Claude Code sessions on one screen and restores disconnected sessions.

items.title: AI agent web apps and training LMS for LG
items.what: I built an interview agent, an agent builder, a multi-agent panel discussion web app, and an LMS for running the courses, and used them in actual training.
items.result: 973 total participants, 79 concurrent users with no downtime
more: Next.js, Supabase, Gemini. The conversational practice apps use LangGraph and FastAPI.
Several course cohorts can be scheduled at once, and the apps participants build are collected in a gallery.

items.title: TOPIK test item and lecture video pipeline
items.meta: 2025.11 – 2026.10 · with E4NET · delivered and handed over
items.what: I designed and built a pipeline that runs from item generation through explanations, TTS, slides, video composition and multilingual subtitles, and replaced manual review steps with measurable automatic pass criteria.
items.result: 43 explanation videos (341.5 min), 57 videos each in Burmese and Bengali, 45 writing mock-test sets
more: 27 role-specific subagents split the stages; each stage hands off only after its output passes JSON Schema validation.
LLMs handle generation; rule engines and scripts enforce deterministic constraints such as a single correct answer, format and sync.
All operating assets were handed over in September 2026.

items.title: Seoul Now: real-time city status map
items.what: A free web service that puts real-time crowd levels at Seoul landmarks together with traffic, subway, parking, Ttareungyi (Seoul's public bikes), weather and fine particulate (PM2.5/PM10) levels on one map.
items.result: 121 places, built on public APIs

items.title: Fold8 and Mac integration tools (android-mac-lab)
items.what: In about a week with Claude Code, I built and published tools that let a Galaxy Z Fold8 work as a Mac's secondary monitor, microphone and remote screen, along with an Android voice agent.
items.result: 11 public repositories, 12 stars on the hub repository
more: deskpad-fold: uses the Fold8 as a secondary monitor for the Mac.
fold-agent: tell it what to do and the phone opens apps and taps. Irreversible actions go through a confirmation step defined in code, not by the model.
foldmic, clipbridge, fold-cyberdeck, cmux-mobile-remote and others.

items.title: Two-way real-time interpretation subtitles for video meetings (macOS)
items.what: When I speak Korean, subtitles in the other person's language appear only on their screen; when they speak, Korean subtitles appear only on mine. The other person installs nothing.
items.result: Built on Gemini Live translation, with my own engine for language detection and latency handling

items.title: Web book "How to Draw a Knowledge Map" (in Korean)
items.what: A web book on organizing personal and organizational records with LLM wikis, ontologies and RAG. I published it as the material for Monthly CMDS session 22.
items.result: In the appendix, I ran NVIDIA Auto-Ontology on a public sample DB and found why the example questions returned wrong values (59 missing foreign keys between schemas).

items.title: 3D museum web app
items.what: A three.js recreation of the Cour Marly in the Louvre's Richelieu wing, where you walk around in the browser and view classical sculptures in 3D.
more: I also built a 3D online lecture hall (120 people, screen sharing, group tables).
